question: Q-W-M1-D4
text: Which salesperson's gross margin % fell the most from FY2014 to FY2015, and which stock groups drove the change?
interpretation: Salesperson whose gross margin % fell the most from FY2014 to FY2015 (ties: name); for that salesperson, per stock group: gross margin % in each year, change in points, and FY2015 revenue; ordered by change ascending (largest drop first).
assemble: WITH sp AS (SELECT salesperson, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2014 THEN gross_margin_pct END) AS gm_2014, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2015 THEN gross_margin_pct END) AS gm_2015 FROM people WHERE lines > 0 GROUP BY salesperson), worst AS (SELECT salesperson, gm_2014, gm_2015 FROM sp ORDER BY gm_2015 - gm_2014, salesperson LIMIT 1), bg AS (SELECT g.stock_group_name, MAX(CASE WHEN g.fiscal_year = 2014 THEN g.gross_margin_pct END) AS gm_2014, MAX(CASE WHEN g.fiscal_year = 2015 THEN g.gross_margin_pct END) AS gm_2015, MAX(CASE WHEN g.fiscal_year = 2015 THEN g.revenue END) AS revenue_fy2015 FROM groups g JOIN worst w ON w.salesperson = g.salesperson WHERE g.lines > 0 GROUP BY g.stock_group_name) SELECT w.salesperson, w.gm_2014 AS salesperson_gm_fy2014, w.gm_2015 AS salesperson_gm_fy2015, bg.stock_group_name, bg.gm_2014 AS group_gm_fy2014, bg.gm_2015 AS group_gm_fy2015, (bg.gm_2015 - bg.gm_2014) * 100 AS group_change_points, bg.revenue_fy2015 FROM bg CROSS JOIN worst w ORDER BY group_change_points NULLS FIRST, bg.stock_group_name
